Body.Content:
This capability directly impacts metric calculations, improving accuracy and delivering the following benefits:

Tracks when interactions enter and exit queues, providing clearer operational visibility.

Calculates wait time, service level, and abandonment for each queue segment, enabling more precise performance evaluation.

Preserves metric accuracy during cross-queue transfers, minimizing errors and inconsistencies.

Surfaces customer wait times after transfers, offering deeper insights than session-level metrics.

Ensures consistent and reliable reporting by evaluating service adherence at every queue entry.

Business Value:

Tracking segment-level metrics across queues enables contact center leads to measure performance at each queue entry within a single customer interaction. Unlike conversation-level metrics, which mask post-transfer wait times, abandonment, and service level performance, segment-level metrics hold each queue accountable for its outcomes. This visibility helps supervisors pinpoint operational bottlenecks such as agent rejections, timeouts, or misrouted transfers, improving SLA accuracy, workforce planning, and routing decisions. The result is reduced abandonment, better post-transfer experiences, and more consistent service across complex interaction flows.

Enabled for:

Enabled for admins/makers/marketers automatically

GA date: June CY2026
